# Boost Social

> Boost Social is an affordable, always-on marketing subscription for small and
> independent businesses — especially restaurants, hotels, gyms, salons and
> lifestyle brands. It runs your social media, ads, newsletters and AI search
> visibility for you, from £500/month, with no long contract. A Wonder Group company.

## What Boost Social does
- Social media management: four posts a week, real creator photo and video, captions in your brand voice, scheduled across your channels.
- Targeted ads: local Meta/Instagram/TikTok ad campaigns, built and managed, tested monthly, with a report on results. Ad spend paid separately to the platforms.
- Newsletters: a branded email newsletter written, designed and sent to your list every month.
- AI search visibility (AI Boost): your business written up and listed so Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT recommend you by name.
- Websites: a site designed to turn visits into bookings, optimised for Google and AI search, hosting and updates included.

## Pricing (per month, GBP)
- Social: £500 — the base plan (social media management).
- Social + Ads: £800 — recommended; adds managed local advertising (ad spend extra).
- Full Boost: £999 — everything, including newsletters and AI listings, priority turnaround.
- Add-ons: Newsletters £200, AI Boost £99, Website £250 (12-month term).
- Social, ads, newsletters and AI listings are month-to-month — cancel any time.

## Who it's for
Independent and small hospitality and lifestyle businesses that want consistent,
professional marketing without agency prices or long contracts.
